WEDNESDAY 08:30 AM SPOT COUNSELING FOR ALL REGISTERED CANDIDATES 
 
 
 
GUIDELINES 
1. This notification shall be treated as an individual intimation and no separate 
intimation will be issued.  
2. The seats in B.Sc. (Hons) Agriculture and B.Tech. (Food Technology) courses will 
be filled in as per the Presidential Order and rule of reservation based on the A.P. 
EAPCET 2026 Ranks  and other GOs issued by the Government from time to 
time. 
3. Manual counsel ling does not guarantee admission into courses for 
everyone who have been called for. 
4. Candidates should arrive at the counselling centre one hour before  the 
scheduled time with all original documents indicated in the information brochure 
and advised to pay the necessary fees at the allotted college.  
5. If the candidate arrives late after commencement/ completion of counselling 
he/she has no right to claim the seats which are already allotted as per 
University Guidelines.  
6. 15 % seats shall be Un-Reserved (UR) for candidates from AU / SVU.   
7. For the 85% local seats, the seats shall be allocated in 65.62 : 34.38 ratio in 
Andhra University and Sri Venkateswara University area, respectively among the 
candidates in relation to the local area.  
8. In case, the information furnished or the certificates uploaded by the candidates 
are found to be false, the University will take appropriate action against the 
individual concerned. 
9. Since more number of candidates are called for this manual counselling for filing 
the vacant seats, it is likely that counselling process may extend to late in the 
evening. Hence the candidates and parents/ guardians are requested to come 
prepared for staying late. 
10. Registered candidates who have attended for physical verification on 
Dt.16.09.2026 and Dt.23.09.2026 at Krishna Auditorium, RARS, Lam, Guntur 
(eligible priority list s for special category as displayed in the University website ) 
who joined / not j oined during first and second phase of counselling are also 
eligible for this manual counselling for sliding / changing colleges. 
11. Candidates called for counselling will have to attend at their own cost and only 
one parent / guardian of the candidate will b e allowed to accompany the 
candidate during the counselling process. 
12. The candidates are required to submit all the relevant original certificates or 
custodian certificate issued by Associate Dean (for already joined students in the 
college) and fee receipt from the College at the time of counselling and selected 
candidates have to come prepared to pay the requisite fee (already given in 
website) immediately  on the counselling day itself at the respective college 
counters, failing which the seat stands cancelled. 
13. Fee should be paid immediately after securing admission in CASH mode 
only. No ONLINE / UPI transactions are accepted:

14. The following registered candidates (Including special category) are eligible 
for the counselling: 
a. Who secured a seat in the earlier phase of counseling and wish to 
move to some other colleges as per their merit and rule of reservation 
b. Registered candidates who participated in earlier phases  of 
counseling and could not secure a seat. 
c. Registered candidates who did not participate in the earlier phase. 
d. Registered candidates who were allotted a seat but didn’t report/pay 
the fee at the college. 
e. Registered candidate allotted a seat in an earlier phase but canceled 
his/her admission. 
All the candidates are informed to visit the website (angrau.ac.in) for seat 
availability position before attending the counselling , which will be updated 
regularly during the counselling days.
